title: Local harmonic representatives of a distributionally harmonic L^1(B) function
statement: Let n >= 1, B the open unit ball of R^n, and w : R^n -> R integrable on B with int_B w Laplacian(zeta) = 0 for every zeta in C^infinity(R^n) with compact support and tsupport zeta in B. Then for every eps with 0 < eps < 1/2 there is v : R^n -> R that is harmonic near every point of ball(0, 1 - eps) (InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd) and satisfies v = w almost everywhere on ball(0, 1 - 2 eps).
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ w : Rn n → ℝ, IntegrableOn w (ball (0 : Rn n) 1) → (∀ ζ : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball 0 1 → ∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, w x * Laplacian.laplacian ζ x = 0) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 2 → ∃ v : Rn n → ℝ, InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd v (ball (0 : Rn n) (1 - ε)) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) (1 - 2 * ε))), v x = w x
